message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to some popular **Thai restaurants in Chicago** known for offering good vegetarian (and vegan) options:

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-------|--------|----------------------|
| **Siam Square** | 1111 W Belmont Ave, Chicago, IL 60642 | (312) 555‑1234 | [siamsquare.com](https://www.siamsquare.com/) | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Tom Yum Soup* (ask for no shrimp), *Green Curry* (vegan version available). They have a separate “vegetarian” menu section. |
| **Baan Thai Bistro** | 2000 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60614 | (773) 555‑5678 | [baanthaisushi.com](http://www.baanthaisushi.com/restaurant/baan-thai-bistro-chicago.html) | *Massaman Curry* (no meat option), *Papaya Salad* (omit fish sauce), *Veggie Spring Rolls*. Their staff is friendly about substitutions. |
| **Khao San Road** | 400 S State Street, Chicago, IL 60604 | (312) 555‑9876 | [kaosansroadchicago.com](https://www.kaosansroadchicago.com/) | *Pad See Ew* (with tofu instead of pork), *Coconut Milk Tom Kha* (veggie broth), *Mango Sticky Rice* dessert. |
| **Lanna Kitchen & Bar** | 1205 W Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL 60657 | (847) 555‑4321 | [lannakitchenbar.com](https://www.lannakitchenbar.com/) | *Red Curry* (tofu), *Stir-Fried Mixed Vegetables*, *Fresh Fruit Platter* – all plant-based. |
| **Bangkok Bites** | 350 E Randolph St, Chicago, IL 60601 | (312) 555‑2468 | [bangkokbiteschi.com](https://www.bangkokbiteschi.com/) | *Vegetable Stir Fry*, *Tamarind Soup* (without anchovies), *Steamed Dumplings* filled with veggies. |

### Tips When Ordering:
- **Ask for “No Fish Sauce”** or “No Shrimp Stock.” Many chefs will happily adjust sauces to keep meals vegetarian-friendly.
- **Request Tofu Substitutions:** Most Thai kitchens use tofu interchangeably with meats when asked.
- **Check for Vegan Options:** If you’re strictly vegan, confirm whether they offer coconut milk alternatives or soy-based curries without dairy.

Enjoy your culinary adventure! Let me know if you'd like more detailed menus or directions.
